message: Release V5.0.1: seven realms, RTS hero squads, careers, pet fusion and painted equipment

Release V11: living camp, original NPC and shop art, companion animation and 2.5D visuals

Add 18 camp encounters, 15 persistent treasure chests, 8 interactive NPCs, 12 illustrated shop goods and a rewarded exploration quest. Synchronize pet damage with windup/travel/impact, add independent pet following and five-stage class appearance layers. Preserve V10 saves and core systems. Verified 119 checks, 20,000 fusion trials, a 36,000-tick combat soak and 30 FPS low-quality browser sample.
V30: owner-aware equipment tempering, sustainable five-element economy, isolated infinite overlay and articulated original armour
V32: rebuild articulated running, attacks and seated riding; improve armour and pet silhouettes
V32: keep walking and running gait continuous across speed changes
